Home.heading: Solid defaults for launching a public web app
Home.description: Domain-based i18n, App Router, SEO, and local typography are already wired into a clean baseline.

panel.title: Add your product screens on top
panel.body: Routing and message structure are already in place, so new pages can focus on content and business logic.

server.title: Server-first rendering
server.body: The base pages render as RSC, keeping the initial response and SEO path straightforward.
server.detail: Client code is added only where it is needed

routing.title: Clean public URLs
routing.body: Locale segments stay out of the browser path while domains and middleware decide the active language.

font.title: Stable base typography
font.body: Local Pretendard Variable keeps the text experience consistent without relying on a font network request.
font.detail: It is connected through the global sans stack

about.title: Review the structure in detail

About.heading: Keep new pages consistent as the app grows
About.description: Routes, messages, metadata, and sitemap entries are handled as one flow so even small pages follow the same standard.

panel.title: /about
panel.body: The file lives below the locale segment, but users only see the clean public path.

routing.title: Separate file path from public URL
routing.body: The file structure follows internal locale matching while the visible URL stays short and predictable.
routing.detail: No locale prefix is shown in the browser

stack.title: Extend from the same baseline
stack.body: Pages share App Router, next-intl, local fonts, and the common SEO metadata builder.
stack.detail: New pages reuse the existing setup

workflow.title: Add pages as one set
workflow.body: Screens, translation keys, metadata, and sitemap entries move together to reduce operational misses.
workflow.detail: The file is only one part of the change

create.title: 1. Create the page file
create.body: Add the public page in a shape like app/[locale]/path/page.tsx.

messages.title: 2. Add the messages
messages.body: Add the same namespace and keys to both locale JSON files.

sitemap.title: 3. Update search metadata
sitemap.body: If the page should be discoverable, update metadata and the sitemap path together.
